The next regeneration finds it. The seat put this to the maintainer, and he chose 「接受残余,落地」 (2026-10-26 13:28Z, devx seat thread). The structural fix, where CI regenerates and compares so the merge queue checks the combination, is filed as #26137 (Tier H, after this PR).
- [x] `skip-changeset`: private root scripts and docs only.

Landing: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once every check on `bc64912d` is green, under the maintainer's standing grant. He may move it up the queue by hand. Every ui registry PR that lands first costs this PR one more re-merge. `Fixes #26051`.
